0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets, now 1-6 and 13th in the East, are on the road against the Atlanta Hawks, who are 5-4, have won their last two games, and lead the Southeast, while the Nets have lost their last game and are 5th in the Atlantic, 6 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4, most recently falling 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Noah Clowney (day-to-day, a game-time decision, knee soreness), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture).
